scope: Fixed source checkout, pinned Go build, native Windows CLI help and configuration validation only; no W10-02 implementation or acceptance

source.version_boundary: This commit contains Unreleased changes; the direct build reports skill-up version dev and does not represent the v0.12.0 release binary.

host_runtime_inventory.default_bash_command: C:/Windows/system32/bash.exe is the WSL shim, which skill-up Windows guide rejects for native .sh judges
host_runtime_inventory.note: Set SKILL_UP_BASH to the existing Git Bash executable for a future native run. No Agent CLI or model was started in this recovery.

source_report_contract.raw_result: iteration-N/result.json is always emitted by internal/runner/runner.go WriteResults from report.Input; report.json is a formatted derivative
source_report_contract.case_dimensions: case_results[] carries case_id, status, configuration (with_skill or without_skill), grading, error, duration, token counts and observed configuration; iteration comes from the result path/run
source_report_contract.unsafe_summary: report.Input.PrimaryCaseResults collapses configurations by case ID; plugins/dsh-skill-up/lib/core.js also summarizes by case_id. Neither is authoritative for variant-by-iteration reconciliation.
source_report_contract.upstream_zero_assertion_risk: internal/judge/judge.go NewResult and evaluator no-judge path can yield PASS without a frozen effective hard assertion; importer must check this independently.

researchos_gap.existing_adapter: adapters/evaluation/evaluation.go Manifest.Validate permits only NATIVE/PROMPTFOO and Normalize consumes flat []Result; no skill-up raw result import exists
researchos_gap.contract_mapping: v2.4 implementation package contracts/domain.schema.json permits SKILL_UP; current product spec/v2.0/contracts/domain.schema.json permits only NATIVE/PROMPTFOO and tests instantiate domain.New with that legacy directory. Product runtime needs a precise v2.4 EvaluationReport engine binding owned by the shared contract owner, preserving the frozen v2.0 snapshot.
researchos_gap.registry: Current v2.4 execution/commands.json lacks test.evaluation.fixture; legacy execution/commands.json binds W10-G03/C21 to ops/ci/evaluation.py, so W10-02 selector requires a shared registration that preserves legacy selectors.
minimal_implementation_scope: adapters/evaluation/skill_up.go: invoke fixed binary and strictly import raw result.json per frozen variant x iteration
adapters/evaluation/skill_up_test.go and tests/evaluation/check/main.py: real CLI fixture plus unknown, duplicate, missing, SKIP, zero-hard-assertion and summary-only rejections
shared owner: precise runtime EvaluationReport/engine v2.4 binding and test.evaluation.fixture selector registration
researchos_gap.first_real_sample: NOT_RUN in source recovery; W10-02 implementation must run a bounded real skill-up CLI fixture before claiming its OUTPUT check

decision: The missing pinned source and runnable Windows CLI have been recovered. This is resource evidence only; W10-02 remains unaccepted until the real CLI sample, adapter, registered selector and independent review pass.
